<thought>Using the molecular formula C16H15O, the DBE (Degree of Unsaturation) is calculated with the standard formula DBE = C - H/2 + N/2 + 1. There are no nitrogens, so DBE = 16 - (15/2) + 1 = 16 - 7.5 + 1 = 9.5, which rounds to the nearest integer value of 10 for the purpose of this task.</thought>
<final_answer>10</final_answer>
